events.title: Ukraine: Critical health supplies destroyed in ongoing Russian attacks
events.summary: Ongoing and deadly Russian attacks across Ukraine are causing serious healthcare disruption, with more than $1.5 million-worth of medicines and supplies destroyed in four separate strikes on warehouses used by the UN there since July.

events.title: Security Council LIVE: Deaths, demolitions spike in Gaza, West Bank
events.summary: Amid a rise in lethal Israeli strikes, demolitions and violence in Gaza and the West Bank, the Security Council held an open debate on Thursday focusing on the current situation in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.
